sap_field: pricing condition record (e.g. condition type PR00)
transform_notes: VBAP has no flat 'unit price' field -- pricing is fully condition-driven in standard SD. Loading this legacy value means creating a price condition record (KONP/KONV, S/4: PRCD_ELEMENTS) representing an imported/manual price, not writing to an item column.

sap_field: KBETR / KWERT (for a discount condition type)
transform_notes: Item-level discount condition record -- same derived-from-conditions pattern as Unit_Price.

Resolve via Foundation>Tax Codes lookup (T007A) to determine the applicable tax code/classification; the actual tax result on the item is a condition record, not a flat VBAP field. Exact condition type depends on the target system's pricing procedure configuration.
Same condition-record pattern as Tax_Code_ID -- not a stored VBAP field.

sap_field: sum of linked LIPS-LFIMG via VBFA document flow
transform_notes: Not a static field on the order item. In a live SD process this is derived by summing delivery item quantities (LIPS-LFIMG) linked back to the order item through the document flow (VBFA) as deliveries post -- SAP maintains it automatically going forward. For orders migrated mid-process (open/partially delivered), the historical value needs a one-time reconciliation rather than a direct field load, since VBFA links must be reconstructed or the figure captured for reporting only.
Stamped automatically on save -- not loaded as source data.
Tracked via change documents automatically -- not loaded as source data.
